messages:
customer_acme: Hi — we signed up for the free trial (acct: acme-inc) and the dashboard shows 1,000 credits. Made two simple generate calls and tokens used in the responses show ~200, but the balance remains 1,000. Can you confirm debits?
ashley_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the request_id or the timestamp of the calls? I can pull logs.
customer_acme: request_id: req_0a9c3f7b, calls around 2026-03-15T14:12:09Z and 2026-03-15T14:12:43Z. Also seeing 200 HTTP 200 with valid responses.
ashley_support: Thanks. Escalating to billing + backend. @sanjay_billing @eli_backend looping in.
sanjay_billing: Looking at ledger for acct acme-inc — I don't see any debit records for those timestamps. There are corresponding `session.start` events but no `session.finalize`. Did the client send an explicit finalize?
eli_backend: Checking logs for req_0a9c3f7b... I see the streaming session opened and closed client-side, but our webhook finalizer failed with a 409 on our side due to duplicate idempotency token. It looks like the client retried and we dropped the finalize event because the retry used a different `finalize_id`.
ashley_support: So the generation succeeded but the finalize that records token consumption didn't make it to billing. Does that mean tokens weren't charged?
sanjay_billing: Correct — our billing job consumes `session.finalize` events to emit ledger debits. If finalize missing, no debit.
ledger_bot: [automated] finalize_processor: failed to publish event: InvalidIdempotencyToken: token mismatch for session sess-42abc (seen at 2026-03-15T14:12:45Z)
eli_backend: Root cause: SDK retry logic produced a duplicate stream with a new finalize_id; the finalize handler is not tolerant of alternate ids. We'll make the finalizer idempotent by session id (not finalize_id) in the next patch.
ashley_support: For immediate mitigation — @customer_acme, we can apply a temporary credit adjustment while we run a correction job to replay missing finalize events. Would you like us to proceed?
customer_acme: Yes please — we'd like the trial to reflect actual usage. Also can you share repro steps so we can check our SDK behavior?
eli_backend: Repro steps for us: use SDK with a network hiccup, allow client to retry the stream without preserving `finalize_id`. Example curl stream snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "stream": true, "session_id": "sess-42abc" }
# simulate network retry -> resend stream with same session_id but different finalize_id
```
We expect server to accept finalize if session_id matches.
sanjay_billing: I'll queue a correction job to reconcile `session.start`/`message` logs with missing `session.finalize` and emit debits. Will also issue a manual debit for the two calls now so dashboard matches.
ops_oncall: Patch for finalizer idempotency will be deployed to canary in ~30m. After canary validation we'll roll to prod.
ashley_support: Done — I credited 200 tokens to acme-inc while billing runs the correction job. You should see the balance update in <5m. Sorry for the churn — we'll follow up when backfill completes. :thumbsup:
customer_acme: Balance updated, thanks. Appreciate the fast help.
ashley_support: Following up: ticket created BF-4532 to track root cause + fix. Will post updates here when backfill job completes.
eli_backend: Update at 16:20 UTC — canary finalizer change looks good, proceeding with prod roll.
sanjay_billing: Backfill job finished — we emitted two ledger entries for sess-42abc. Wallet balance and historic usage should now show correctly.
ashley_support: Closing loop — credits reconciled and fix merged to main. If anything odd persists, please reopen. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
